At Macadam, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over 15 million users worldwide, we help individuals turn their daily steps into positive habits for health, wellbeing, and sustainability.

Our team is growing fast, and our ambitions are global. We operate at the intersection of health, gamification, and technology, and we're building a world-class data team to support this growth.

If you’re passionate about using data and machine learning to build products that improve lives at scale, we’d love to meet you.

Please submit your CV in English.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape Macadam’s product and growth strategy through machine learning, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

You will work on high-impact topics such as personalization, user engagement, retention, monetization, fraud prevention, and reward economy optimization. This is a hands-on senior role with ownership from problem definition through deployment and impact measurement.

You will partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics teams to build data-driven solutions used by millions of users.

This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identify and lead data science opportunities that improve growth, engagement, retention, revenue, and user experience
Build machine learning models for personalization, recommendations, user behavior prediction, segmentation, and forecasting
Develop solutions supporting churn prevention, lifetime value optimization, fraud detection, and Macadam’s reward economy
Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, causal inference, and other advanced statistical methods
Take models from initial exploration to production, working closely with Data and Engineering teams
Define clear success metrics and evaluate solutions based on measurable product and business impact
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to Macadam’s data science roadmap, standards, and best practices




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Science, or a similar role
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience using BigQuery, GCP, dbt, and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel or Firebase Analytics
Experience developing, deploying, and evaluating machine learning models
Familiarity with data pipelines and production machine learning workflows
Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, experimentation, and model evaluation
Experience working with large behavioral, transactional, or product datasets
Strong product and business mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Fluent in English




NICE TO HAVE

Experience with consumer mobile apps, gaming, advertising, loyalty, or rewards products
Experience with recommender systems, personalization, churn, LTV, or fraud models
Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, or large-scale experimentation
Familiarity with mobile attribution frameworks, including Apple’s SKAdNetwork




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Be part of a mission-driven company making a tangible difference in people's lives, one step at a time.
Real ownership: lead high-impact data science initiatives and build solutions used by millions from day one.
Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and international exposure.
A supportive, talented, and passionate international team.
Offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Meal voucher.
Wellness allowance (powered by Urban Sports).
Private healthcare (Alan).
Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
4 additional Macadam holiday days.
Friday team lunch.
Company events and offsites.

We don’t just talk about change - we walk it.

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Pricing
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our marketplace. You’ll join the Pricing & Quality team (a mix of data scientists and backend engineers) focused on curating offers to give customers the best value for money.

Your focus: implement models and algorithms to optimize fees and pricing.

What You’ll Do


Drive pricing intelligence: design and implement Machine Learning models and optimization algorithms that directly fuel a comprehensive suite of pricing levers
Own projects end to end: from problem definition and metrics design, through data extraction and model implementation, to presenting results to business and product stakeholders.
Collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to translate models into production-ready features
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of fee strategies or model changes.
Leverage statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights and inform critical tech, business and product decisions
Communicate your work clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders.


About You


At least 5 years of industry experience as a data scientist and Master’s (or PhD ) in a quantitative discipline such as Statistics, Economics or Engineering
Impact-driven: You’ve contributed to data science projects that made a real impact on live, customer-facing products — not just in theory, but in production.
Comfortable with ambiguity: you are able to make decisions and propose directions even when the problem is not fully defined or the data is imperfect
Strong grasp of machine learning and statistical concepts and know how to choose the right model for the problem and make it work in a production environment.
Practical expertise in experimentation design and analysis.
Proficient in Python and SQL, and familiarity with software engineering principles around testing, code reviews, and deployment
Clear communicator: You are comfortable explaining complex ideas and results to diverse audiences, including senior management.
Experience in pricing, B2C marketplaces or revenue management is a strong plus.


Recruitment process


Call with one of our Tech recruiter (1h)
Technical screening (30 min)
Technical Interview (1h15)
Stakeholder interview (1h)
Meet your manager (30min)
Back Market Values fit interview (45 min)


WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

Benefits

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:


A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.


At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Title: Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology
Description:
Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology




We are working with a Berlin based AI-native patient intelligence company, backed by leading European healthtech investors. Their platform captures something the life sciences industry has never been able to access at scale: the patient's own account of living with a chronic or rare condition.




About the role




This role puts you at the heart of how that data becomes intelligence.

Working closely with their Chief AI Officer, you'll take unstructured patient narratives, hundreds of data points per person, and turn them into the models, metrics, and evidence that our clients act on. The questions are genuinely open: how do you quantify a patient journey? What signals predict a treatment switch? Where does the data reveal unmet need no one has named yet?




It's a role with unusually short distance between analysis and impact. What you build ships into a live product, in front of global life science teams, and shapes decisions that reach patients with chronic conditions worldwide.




What you'll do




Analyze and model large, multi-modal patient datasets to surface insights on patient journeys and unmet needs
Partner with the Chief AI Officer to develop, validate, and scale the algorithms behind our Patient Journey Analytics Platform
Work with engineers and product managers to turn data insights into user-facing features
Design and implement pipelines for data cleaning, feature engineering, and predictive modeling
Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, shaping how life science companies make decisions
Keep pace with state-of-the-art ML/AI methods and bring new ideas into our production stack




What you'll bring




3+ years' professional experience as a Data Scientist, ideally in healthtech, SaaS, or a related field
Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow or similar)
Strong SQL and experience with both structured and unstructured data
Solid grounding in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Ability to run independently on complex problems while collaborating closely with product and engineering
Full professional fluency in English, written and spoken




If you are an experienced Data Scientist who wants to make a true impact with a positive mission, please get in touch.

Title: Data Scientist, Applied Science
Description:
Do you want to drive the next urban revolution? At Cabify, that’s what we’re doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we’ve still got a long way to go… want to be part of this journey?

About The Position

You will join Cabify’s Applied Science team, a group of highly motivated data scientists with access to all data within the organization. The team is involved in all main areas of the company, including vehicle and route management, understanding user experience, pricing, fraud detection, and marketing optimization (see for yourself: exhibit A, exhibit B, exhibit C). You will work with state-of-the-art tools and infrastructure to help improve everyday operations in more than 40 cities worldwide. Cabify's Applied Science team provides a unique opportunity to research, test and implement great ideas that will shape the future of our cities.

As a Data Scientist in our team, you will:


Develop high-impact data science projects, working closely with other data, engineering, product and business teams.
Design, train, and validate statistical and machine learning models and help deploying them into production.
Participate in the results analysis of real-life experiments, following academy-standard scientific methods and procedures, to demonstrate the impact of the new product features we develop.
Help to convert the team’s technical knowledge into real and tangible business insights that bring value to the company.
Join product development conversations, discussing new features and bringing the data science perspective to everything we build.


What we’re looking for


At least 3 years of professional experience working as a data scientist or equivalent research role.
Strong educational background, e.g Masters in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, etc.
Solid foundations in Probability & Statistics.
Experience designing, training and validating statistical and machine learning models.
Experience working with Python for data analysis and data visualization libraries.
Experience with data extraction and processing. Capable of writing complex SQL code.
Ability to work autonomously in an unstructured environment.


Bonus Points


Experience bringing machine learning to production, with all its subtleties: deploying, training, testing, model degradation, model serving, etc.
Experience with state-of-the-art methods in topics like deep learning models, time series analysis, bayesian statistics, causal inference, etc.
Experience with geo data modeling, analysis and visualization.


What’s it like to work at Cabify?

We’re a company full of happy, motivated people and we never want that to change. Here are some more reasons why it rocks to be part of our high-performance team:

💶 Excellent Salary conditions: 38K - 53K€

🌍 Our office is located in Madrid.

⌚ Flexible work environment & hours.

🙌 Regular team events.

🚗 Cabify staff free rides.

🚀 Personal development programs based on our career paths.

📐 Coursera: your own license in Coursera to take as many courses as you wish and continue developing your skills.

🧘‍♀️ iFeel: Free access to the iFeel platform, so you can take care of your emotional well-being through therapy sessions.

☕️ And last but not least...free coffee and fruit!

Join us!

Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.




Sobre la posición.




Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.




¿Qué harás?





Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.


Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.


Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.


Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.


Tuning de modelos ML/DL.


Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.


Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).


Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.


Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.


Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.





Timing de primeras semanas en OGA




Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).


Experiencia de más de 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 3 años como consultor senior liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.


Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.

Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.


Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.


Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.


Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.


Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.


Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.


Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.


Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.


Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.


Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.


Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.


Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.


Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

¡Te esperamos!

Title: Data Scientist – Python & Cloud Data Platforms (f/m/x)
Description:
We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.

You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem.

What We Offer

AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else.

AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily.

Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you.

Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored.

Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses.

Your tasks


Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand
Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality
Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels
Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny
Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows)
Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production
Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle


Requirements


At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage
Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise
Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP)
Ability to communicate analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and influence decisions with data
Familiarity with working autonomously while collaborating effectively with data engineers, architects, and product teams
Fluent English, both written and spoken
Fluent Polish required
Residing in Poland required


Nice to have


Production experience with Microsoft Fabric or Palantir Foundry certification (Foundry Data Engineer / Data Scientist tracks)
Experience with time series forecasting, NLP, recommender systems, or exposure to LLM-based workflows
Familiarity with MLOps practices: MLflow, experiment tracking, model versioning, and CI/CD for ML
Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, and distributed processing with Spark/PySpark

Title: Senior Data Scientist - Care AI
Description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

About The Role

As part of the Bureau of Technology, you’ll design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions to improve our Customer Care. You’ll join a new team, Care AI (a mix of data scientists and software engineers) focused on enhancing the experience of our customers in need of help with faster and more precise resolutions.

Your focus will be in implementing and scaling our Care AI agents and improving AI powered features aimed at increasing agents efficiency, detecting customer sentiment and speeding up resolutions.

What You Will Do


Identify company problems and opportunities that AI can address, own them end-to-end, from problem definition to production rollout, collaborating with stakeholders and relevant teams to design and ship the product features that solves them.
Hands-on development, productionisation, and operation of machine learning models and/or GenAI applications at scale. This includes integrating and optimizing LLMs for production environments.
Contribute to the development of the AI community within the company by promoting best practices and sharing your work internally to raise awareness about AI capabilities
Regularly present work internally (demo, internal conferences,...) to technical, engineering and product stakeholders to acculturate the business to AI related topics


About You


6+ years of industry experience in data science or related fields, with a Master's or PhD in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Economics, Sciences, or Engineering)
Proven track record of leading impactful data science initiatives that solve real business problems, with the ability to mentor and develop scientists, engineers, and peers
Deep knowledge of the ML lifecycle, algorithms, best practices, and hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and Generative AI APIs
Strong ability to design end-to-end AI and data architectures that integrate with existing product systems, data platforms, and engineering infrastructure, with solid Python skills and software engineering fundamentals (testing, code review, deployment)
Proficiency in AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code), and strong communication skills to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences


Recruitment Process


Call with Stéphane, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner (1h)
Technical screening (30 min)

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a key role in advancing our physiological feature pipeline and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with biomarker and wearable health data. This role is ideal for an experienced ML expert who has expertise around health data, thrives in ambiguous problem spaces, and brings a balance of hands-on technical depth and strategic thinking.

You will work within our Product Science team, and we seek a data scientist who thrives in dynamic environments and is prepared to pioneer in uncharted territory accompanied with a creative approach to algorithmic development.

Location: Finland, we have offices in Helsinki and Oulu

What You Will Do


Contribute to development of new human physiology based features and new sensor technology
Transform multi-sensor data into actionable health metrics by combining insights from diverse biosensing technologies with state-of-the-art data science methodologies
Develop reusable data analytics tools, which can be deployed at scale
Actively participate in developing and refining the team’s strategic roadmap, innovating and prioritising initiatives, and aligning project goals with broader organisational objectives
Lead data collections, write scientific reports, publications and white papers, and present findings internally (leadership and stakeholders) and externally (conferences, etc.)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and overseas stakeholders


We would love to have you on our team if you have:


Have 6+ years of experience in Data Science with sparse real world data, most likely wearable data with excellent physiological understanding
Considers Python as their Mother Tongue and has a strong track record in developing deep learning and multimodal data fusion for sequential data.
Experience with forecasting models, optimization models, statistical analysis, and running simulations.
Have an advanced degree (Masters/Doctor) in a STEM-related field (e.g. engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics) or equivalent work experience
Expert level experience building and deploying data science products using AWS tools, SQL, GitHub, and Pytorch
Strong project management experience and is comfortable working with a diverse, distributed and talented group of team members
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrates a proactive mindset, thriving in uncharted territories with the resilience and creativity to navigate ambiguity and deliver solutions in the face of obstacles


What We Offer


Competitive Salary
Lunch benefit
Wellness benefit
Flexible working hours
Collaborative, smart teammates
An Oura ring of your own

Title: Senior Data Scientist (all genders)
Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team. In this high-impact role, you will be the expert driving our success by creating and optimizing critical areas like User Acquisition models, LTV predictions, and Ad Monetization strategies. You will shape our product roadmap through in-depth Product Analytics and ensure data-driven growth by leading A/B testing initiatives with scientific rigor. If you thrive in a fast-growing and dynamic company and want to have real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Job Requirements


6+ years of professional experience in data science, focusing on machine learning, statistical analysis, and deep learning. Ideally paired with experience in the mobile gaming industry
Proven expertise in user acquisition modeling, product analytics, and A/B testing methodologies and tools
Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Familiarity with SQL for database querying and data manipulation
Strong knowledge of statistical methods and their application in business
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) is a plus
Strong project management skills, with a track record of leading data science projects
Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate data into insights
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment
You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.


Nice-to haves:


Experience with mobile gaming analytics
Hands-on experience with Looker for data visualization and reporting
Familiarity with ad tech tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Audience Network, Firebase)
Knowledge of reinforcement learning and its applications in gaming or ad optimization


Job Requirements


Predictive User Modeling: You will build and optimize machine learning models to understand and predict user behavior across the full lifecycle - acquisition, engagement, churn, and LTV. Partner with marketing, product, and growth teams to turn those predictions into measurable business impact.
Product Analytics: You will be responsible for conducting in-depth product analysis to identify key metrics and areas for improvement, using data insights to guide product development and enhance user experience. Additionally, you will collaborate with product managers to steer data-driven features and improvements
A/B Testing: You will collaborate closely with the product team to design, implement, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests to optimize product features and marketing strategies. During those initiatives, you will be responsible for ensuring scientific rigor and proper statistical methods. Finally, you will support interpreting the results and providing actionable insights to stakeholders
Machine Learning & Statistical Analysis: You will develop and deploy machine learning models for predictive analytics, user segmentation, and personalization, while applying deep learning techniques for complex data analysis tasks (image recognition, natural language processing, etc.) to drive user acquisition and monetization of our JustPlay app
Project Management: Lead data science projects from concept to delivery, coordinating with cross-functional teams (including Engineering, Product, and marketing) and managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication


Job Benefits


Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers
Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner nilo.health to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work
Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc.
Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution
State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed
A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it
Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.
Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations


* Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

About Us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning, Deep Learning et de modélisation mathématique.
Réaliser les analyses exploratoires (EDA), le prétraitement des données, la sélection de variables et la validation statistique.

Vous disposez de solides compétences en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques et apprentissage automatique.
Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se) et appréciez le travail en équipe.

Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Machine Learning & Deep Learning
XGBoost, LightGBM, Hugging Face (un plus)
Environnements Cloud : AWS, Azure ou GCP
Outils de datavisualisation : Plotly, Power BI, Streamlit
Méthodologies Agile




Les plus :




Intérêt pour le NLP, la Computer Vision ou l'IA générative.
Connaissance des secteurs industriel ou aéronautique.
Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais.

Title: Data Scientist – Scoring Center (M/F)
Description:
Present in more than 30 countries, BNP Paribas Personal Finance leads the personal and consumer credit business. In some markets we are leaders, and we bet on innovation to open up new opportunities, in others we are a fast growing business. In all markets, we value relationships, knowledge sharing and responsible action

In practice, your day-to-day


As a Data Scientist in the Scoring Center team, you will undertake projects to build risk prediction models. Your main responsibilities will be:
As part of your modelling projects, you assess the needs expressed, define and propose the adapted deliverables and estimate their burden and time frame through an implementation plan that takes into account the challenges and constraints. You use statistical modelling methods (such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting…), analyze and explain the results
You lead the project, keep track of the schedule and support the implementation and monitoring of the tools issued
As part of the monitoring and optimization of the BNP Paribas Personal Finance score models, you participate in the monitoring campaigns of the scores: generation and analysis of monitoring results, diagnosis and action plan
You are also responsible for conducting or analyzing statistical studies related to risk prediction models. If necessary, you take part in analytical support missions to the Group's international entities and in the processing of audit recommendations relating to the Basel regulatory project
In addition, you actively contribute to the transversal missions of the Scoring Center: technological and methodological watch, regulatory watch, training, analytical support for the Group's international entities

The Mission is important, but so is the Team and the workplace!


Welcome to BNP Paribas Personal Finance, where you will integrate the Analytics Hub, an innovative, international and creative team. Our working language is English
You will be in the Scoring Center teams that are made up of 30 Data Scientists that will work with you. The team in Lisbon is new and everyone is growing together. You'll be surrounded by colleagues working in the same field as you, sharing ideas and experiences
We are prepared to welcome you with an initial onboarding plan, with on-the-job training, online learning and networking opportunities


What do we have to offer you?


This is a very important topic that we will address together, taking into account your training and experience.


Are you the one we are looking for?


Do you have a Degree in Data Science, Mathematics or Statistics?
Do you have a scientific background and at least 3 years of experience in a statistical or risk environment, preferably modelling in banking or insurance environment?"
Do you have good skills in Python?
Are you proficient in modelling environment or data lab and have a strong knowledge of the main data science libraries?
Do you have experience in machine models industrialization?
Are you able to work on several projects in parallel and are acknowledge for your accuracy?
Are you fluent in oral and written English?
If you recognize yourself in this description, and have a lot of enthusiasm, energy and motivation, then you are the one we are looking for!
We look forward to your application!

Title: Data scientist confirmé F/H
Company: Commissariat au Numérique de Défense - CND
Description:
Information sur l'entreprise

La délégation à la transformation et à la performance ministérielles (DTPM) assure, pour le compte du secrétaire général pour l'administration (SGA), la mission générale de modernisation de l'administration du ministère. Elle concentre à cet effet ses actions sur trois axes complémentaires, le conseil, le numérique et l'innovation et intervient, selon le cas, sur différents périmètres, ministériel, fonctionnel ou organique, aussi bien pour mettre en œuvre des actions relevant d'une administration centrale classique que d'une administration de mission.

La DTPM est forte de près de cent trente agents, répartis en trois départements : une agence ministérielle de conseil (AMC), un nouveau service de transformation numérique (STN) et un département du management et de la transformation interne (DMTI). Le centre d’expertise données et intelligence artificielle (CEDIA) du SGA est rattaché au sein du STN. Le centre est chargé de contribuer au domaine de l’intelligence artificielle organique de défense plus précisément le périmètre administration et soutien. Il est un des acteurs clé du domaine IA au sein du ministère.




Description

Le Data Scientist Confirmé intègre l’équipe en tant que référent technique/ scientifique, il est chargé d’accompagner les juniors dans leur montée en compétences tout en participant à la réalisation des projets data 360 et IA. Il est également en charge de l’utilisation des technologies Big Data et IA, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision et faire de la veille technologique sur les architectures Big Data et IA

Vous aurez la responsabilité de :

• Analyser des données pour traduire une problématique métier en problème mathématique statistique, et réciproquement

• Anticiper avantages/inconvénients de différents modèles ou méthodes calcul dans environnement métier après comparaison et évaluation de ces modèles

• Apporter expertise pour exploration/analyse complexe de données au moyen techniques variées : statistiques, analyse texte, comportementale, images

• Caractériser des données (qualité, richesse, contenu) en vue de leur intégration dans le système d'information cible du métier et créer des algorithmes de recherche de données permettant d'explorer les données utiles

• Produire des rapports et des représentations graphiques à partir des données pertinentes afin de synthétiser et traduire des informations pour faciliter la prise de décision




Profil

Ingénieur diplômé d’une école spécialisée (ENSAE, ENSAI, Polytechnique…) ou d’un master en data science, vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire.

Vous êtes doté de solides compétences techniques autour de Python et packages adaptés, Docker, Git.

Vous avez également de très bonnes capacités interpersonnelles et de communication dans le travail quotidien.

Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

HTML:

Empresa: The Navigator Company

A The Navigator Company pretende reforçar a sua equipa de Tecnologia Digital com a contratação de um/a Data Scientist que irá colaborar em projetos e iniciativas transversais à Companhia garantindo a disponibilização de dados e ferramentas, que amplifiquem o trabalho dos stakeholders internos, permitindo a correta gestão da qualidade, integridade, segurança e tratamento dos dados.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Als Senior Data Scientist bij BigData Republic (part of Conflux) adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties over complexe analytische en AI-vraagstukken. Je combineert diepgaande modelontwikkeling met strategisch advies. Je bouwt production-ready modellen, vertaalt businessdoelstellingen naar datagedreven oplossingen en neemt collega’s mee in je manier van denken.




Je bent geen “notebook-only” data scientist. Je begrijpt dat echte impact ontstaat wanneer modellen schaalbaar, uitlegbaar en onderhoudbaar zijn. Je denkt na over data management, data-ethiek en businessadoptie. Niet alleen over modelperformance.




Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we voorspellende modellen, decisioning-systemen en AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in productie worden gebruikt. We werken vanuit een sterke software-engineering mindset en leggen de lat hoog als het gaat om kwaliteit, reproduceerbaarheid en technische diepgang. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies, schrijven we blogs, spreken we op conferenties en bouwen we aan innovatieve interne projecten. Je werkt circa 90% van je tijd op klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor innovatie, onderzoek of een eigen initiatief.




Wat ga je doen?

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van voorspellende modellen en AI-oplossingen
Vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar mathematische en statistische modellen
Ontwikkelen van end-to-end ML-oplossingen: van exploratie tot productie
Adviseren van stakeholders over datagedreven besluitvorming
Implementeren van MLOps-principes voor robuuste en schaalbare deployment
Begeleiden en coachen van medior/junior data scientists
Bijdragen aan kennisdeling, blogs, meetups en conferenties




Requirements

Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten:

Machine Learning & AI
Supervised & unsupervised learning
Deep learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch of vergelijkbaar)
Feature engineering &modelvalidatie
Explainable AI (SHAP, LIME e.d.)
NLP, Computer Vision of Recommender Systems (pré)




Programmeertalen & Development

Python (essentieel)
SQL
Ervaring met productie-omgevingen en software engineering principes




Cloud & Platform

AWS, GCP en/of Azure
ML-platformen (bijv. Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML)
Containerisatie (Docker)
CI/CD voor ML




Data Engineering Affiniteit

Werken met grote datasets
Begrip van data pipelines en data-platform architecturen
Samenwerking met Data Engineers binnen moderne cloud-omgevingen




Je hoeft niet alles te beheersen. Nieuwsgierigheid, analytische diepgang en het vermogen om impact te maken wegen zwaarder dan een perfecte checklist.




Benefits

Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als Data Scientist
Consultancy-ervaring of sterke stakeholdervaardigheden
Vermogen om technische complexiteit helder uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders

Title: Senior Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Dein Profil


Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder verwandten Feldern
Du bist sicher in der Aufbereitung, Analyse, Manipulation sowie Visualisierung von Daten und verfügst über Programmierkenntnisse (Python) und Erfahrung mit SQL
Du verfügst über ein exzellentes Verständnis von Graph- und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen (Random Forests, Boosting, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), sowie von mathematischer Modellierung (Statistik, Zeitreihenanalyse, Netzwerkanalyse, usw.) und hast praktische Erfahrung mit relevanten Bibliotheken (z.B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost)
Deine hohe Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse zeichnen dich aus


Deine Aufgaben


Du betreust unsere Kunden bei ihren Datenprojekten – von der Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung
Du analysierst, visualisierst und interpretierst komplexe Daten, um relevante Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren
Du bist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Datenqualität durch effektive Datenaufbereitung/-manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), Datenvisualisierung (Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn), sowie der Verarbeitung verschiedener Datenformate (Tabellen, Bilder, Text, Graphen)
Du entwirfst und implementierst Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Lösung komplexer Probleme, wobei du geeignete Algorithmen auswählst und anpasst
Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen und coachst dabei jüngere Teammitglieder

Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Remote Friendly)
Description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Scientist at Docplanner, you will help transform complex data into actionable insights and scalable machine learning solutions that directly impact business growth and operational excellence. You will work on high-impact initiatives across Business, Operations, and Product areas, partnering closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and analytics teams.

You will own data science and BI projects end-to-end - from problem definition and experimentation to model deployment and monitoring - using large-scale datasets and ML infrastructure. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with business understanding and a pragmatic, impact-driven mindset.

This role is part of our Global Data department, supporting data and AI initiatives across Docplanner’s international operations.

How would you be impacting our mission?


Own and deliver end-to-end data science and BI projects, from exploration and experimentation to deployment in production.
Build predictive models and machine learning solutions that support business decision-making and operational efficiency.
Analyze large datasets to uncover actionable insights, trends, and growth opportunities.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure impact and validate hypotheses.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
Improve and maintain scalable data pipelines and ML workflows together with Data & ML engineering teams.
Use modern AI tools, copilots, and AI agents to automate workflows, accelerate experimentation, and improve productivity.
Contribute to best practices in model development, testing, deployment, and documentation.


What will help you thrive?


5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics roles.
Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with libraries such as Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Solid understanding of statistics, experimentation, machine learning, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience working with large datasets, SQL, and data warehouses such as Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake.
Familiarity with MLOps and modern development practices (Git, Docker, MLflow, CI/CD).
Experience using AI-powered tools or AI agents to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks.
Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced, and cross-functional environments.


Bonus points


Experience with Airflow, k8s, Jupyter Notebook, Athena, or other big data technologies.
Experience with NLP, LLMs, or AI agent workflows.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau or Superset.
Previous experience in SaaS or high-growth tech environments.


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Wiktor, Business Intelligence Manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

4️⃣Final Interview – A final conversation with one of your main stakeholder from our Global Team.

5️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Dein Profil


Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder verwandten Feldern
Du bist sicher in der Aufbereitung, Analyse, Manipulation sowie Visualisierung von Daten und verfügst über Programmierkenntnisse (Python) und Erfahrung mit SQL
Du verfügst über ein exzellentes Verständnis von Graph- und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen (Random Forests, Boosting, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), sowie von mathematischer Modellierung (Statistik, Zeitreihenanalyse, Netzwerkanalyse, usw.) und hast praktische Erfahrung mit relevanten Bibliotheken (z.B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost)
Deine hohe Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse zeichnen dich aus


Deine Aufgaben


Du betreust unsere Kunden bei ihren Datenprojekten – von der Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung
Du analysierst, visualisierst und interpretierst komplexe Daten, um relevante Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren
Du bist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Datenqualität durch effektive Datenaufbereitung/-manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), Datenvisualisierung (Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn), sowie der Verarbeitung verschiedener Datenformate (Tabellen, Bilder, Text, Graphen)
Du entwirfst und implementierst Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Lösung komplexer Probleme, wobei du geeignete Algorithmen auswählst und anpasst
Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen und coachst dabei jüngere Teammitglieder

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.




Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and have grown to over 240 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.




Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!




About our tech stack:

Dagster
Snowflake
DBT
Amazon Quick
AWS (Lambda, S3, ECR)




About the role

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic and cross-functional team. As a Senior Data Scientist at Northmill, you will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, fellow Data Scientists, Analysts, and key business stakeholders to proactively identify opportunities and leverage data-driven insights that will drive our business forward. Your primary focus will be on leading data science initiatives across various areas of the bank.




In this holistic role, you will be a part of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection and preparation to implementation. You will work closely with Data Engineers to ensure the availability of high-quality data, as well as with Analysts and business leaders to ensure that your models are effectively applied and communicated across the business. Your contributions will play a vital role in shaping the future of our fintech bank, and your work will have a direct impact on our success.




Responsibilities:

Take proactive ownership of the entire model lifecycle, from data collection, through modeling and analysis, to model deployment and implementation.
Work closely with Data Engineers to acquire and transform data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and advise stakeholders to proactively anticipate business needs and translate them into data science solutions.
Create and present actionable insights and data visualizations that drive decision-making processes across the bank.
Continuously monitor and optimize models to proactively drive model refinement and communicate performance findings to stakeholders.
Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in data science, proactively proposing new initiatives where applicable.




Qualifications

The ideal fit should have experience in statistical modeling and machine learning, from the financial sector, combined with strong problem-solving skills, analytical abilities, excellent stakeholder communication, and a prestigeless, collaborative spirit. We value individuals who are passionate about utilizing data to solve practical challenges and drive business outcomes.




Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics)
+5 years of experience in data science or related roles.
Proficiency in SQL/Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.
Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis and machine learning, including hands-on experience using common ML libraries.
Proficiency with Git and version control in collaborative settings.




What we offer

A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views
An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact
Great opportunities for professional development
Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance
Conference abroad every other year
Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday
Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office




Apply today and be a part of Northmill!

Diseñar e implantar soluciones avanzadas de IA y Machine Learning.
Desarrollar modelos predictivos, algoritmos de aprendizaje y soluciones de IA Generativa.
Transformar necesidades de negocio en casos de uso y soluciones técnicas de valor.
Generar insights accionables a partir de los datos para impulsar la toma de decisiones.
Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de aplicación de IA en productos y procesos de negocio.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares para resolver retos estratégicos mediante tecnologías de inteligencia artificial.

Experiencia en IA Generativa, Machine Learning y analítica avanzada, además:


Gestión de proyectos
Python

Deseable: Experiencia previa en la industria de aerolíneas.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a key role in advancing our physiological feature pipeline and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with biomarker and wearable health data. This role is ideal for an experienced ML expert who has expertise around health data, thrives in ambiguous problem spaces, and brings a balance of hands-on technical depth and strategic thinking.

You will work within our Product Science team, and we seek a data scientist who thrives in dynamic environments and is prepared to pioneer in uncharted territory accompanied with a creative approach to algorithmic development.

Location: Finland, we have offices in Helsinki and Oulu

What You Will Do


Contribute to development of new human physiology based features and new sensor technology
Transform multi-sensor data into actionable health metrics by combining insights from diverse biosensing technologies with state-of-the-art data science methodologies
Develop reusable data analytics tools, which can be deployed at scale
Actively participate in developing and refining the team’s strategic roadmap, innovating and prioritising initiatives, and aligning project goals with broader organisational objectives
Lead data collections, write scientific reports, publications and white papers, and present findings internally (leadership and stakeholders) and externally (conferences, etc.)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and overseas stakeholders


We would love to have you on our team if you have:


Have 6+ years of experience in Data Science with sparse real world data, most likely wearable data with excellent physiological understanding
Considers Python as their Mother Tongue and has a strong track record in developing deep learning and multimodal data fusion for sequential data.
Experience with forecasting models, optimization models, statistical analysis, and running simulations.
Have an advanced degree (Masters/Doctor) in a STEM-related field (e.g. engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics) or equivalent work experience
Expert level experience building and deploying data science products using AWS tools, SQL, GitHub, and Pytorch
Strong project management experience and is comfortable working with a diverse, distributed and talented group of team members
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrates a proactive mindset, thriving in uncharted territories with the resilience and creativity to navigate ambiguity and deliver solutions in the face of obstacles


What We Offer


Competitive Salary
Lunch benefit
Wellness benefit
Flexible working hours
Collaborative, smart teammates
An Oura ring of your own


If this sounds like the next step for you, please send us your application as soon as possible.

Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
